description: This file defines the SubBinary class in the Twig templating engine, specifically for implementing binary subtraction operations within Twig's expression parsing.

classes.name: SubBinary
classes.description: A class representing the subtraction binary operation in Twig's expression syntax, extending AbstractBinary and providing the operator method for outputting the minus sign.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the compiler with the raw '-' operator appended, representing the subtraction operation.
